data.name: Reader
data.Definition: A module in the sources package that reads one AI coding tool's logs or data store and yields usage events. Each reader exposes one Source value.

data.name: Experimental reader
data.Definition: A reader built from a tool's source code and synthetic fixtures but not yet checked against a real session. It is shown with a badge so its numbers are read with that caveat.

data.name: Token data
data.Definition: Whether a reader yields token counts (full) or only the presence of a session (session).

data.name: Root
data.Definition: A folder or file where a reader looks for a tool's data. Defaults are computed per machine and can be replaced with a root the user passes.

data.name: Source
data.description: The frozen description of one reader: id, label, client names, default roots, file lister, parse function, token data flag, display path, optional spans, capabilities, experimental flag and resume hook.

data.name: Spec
data.description: Per tool settings shared by the Cline family readers: source id, client name, extension id, whether input tokens include cache buckets, and whether the SDK store is read.

data.name: Readers only read
data.Statement: A SQLite store is opened through a read only URI and a database error becomes a warning, so a reader never changes the file it measures.

data.name: A reader is found by its SOURCE value
data.Statement: The registry keeps the SOURCE of every module in the readers package except the base module, so adding a reader needs no list edit.

data.name: Unparsable lines are skipped and counted
data.Statement: A JSON Lines reader skips lines that are not valid JSON and adds one warning per file with the count.

data.name: Synthetic Claude Code records are not usage
data.Statement: A Claude Code assistant record with no model or a synthetic model is skipped.

data.name: Repeated Codex token totals are not counted twice
data.Statement: A Codex token_count record whose total is unchanged is skipped, because Codex repeats it on rate limit updates.

data.name: Muse Code control folders are skipped
data.Statement: The Muse Code reader skips the view and model catalog folders when it lists session files.

data.name: Experimental readers carry a flag
data.Statement: A reader whose parser has not been checked against a real session sets experimental to true.

data.name: Cline family token semantics unverified
data.Risk: Cline family token semantics are unverified: it is not known whether input tokens include cache buckets, so cost may be off.
data.Mitigation: The policy is held per source in one table and the module header says to flip it when a real log shows otherwise.

data.name: Copilot CLI and Muse Code unchecked against real logs
data.Risk: Copilot CLI and Muse Code were built without a real log to check against, so their totals may be wrong.
data.Mitigation: Both are flagged experimental and shown with a badge.

data.name: Experimental readers verified?
data.Question: Which experimental readers have been verified against a real session since their module headers were written?

data.name: Muse Code cache write tokens
data.Question: Does Muse Code cache_write_tokens sit inside input_tokens? The module marks it unverified.

data.name: Discover AI tool usage from local files
data.Description: The tool finds the logs and data stores of the supported AI coding tools on this machine and turns each into usage events, without changing any of them.
data.Preconditions: At least one supported tool has written data in a default root, or the user passes a root.
data.Postconditions: Usage events and a file record exist in the usage store for every readable file.
Main flow: 1. The registry collects the SOURCE of every reader module. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/__init__.py:17`
2. The store keeps only the roots that exist. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/base.py:49`
3. The reader lists the files under each root. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:220`
5. The reader parses a changed file into usage events. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:255`
6. The store writes the event rows and a file record. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:281`
data.Alternative flows: A file that cannot be read adds a warning and is skipped. `src/ai_usage_cost/store.py:225`
data.Acceptance criteria: The Claude Code reader skips synthetic and zero token records. `tests/test_claude_code.py:102`

data.name: Read a tool's SQLite store without a token count
data.Description: For tools that keep conversations in a database and record no tokens, the reader still shows that sessions happened, with no token numbers.
data.Preconditions: The tool's database file exists in a default root.
data.Postconditions: One event per composer exists with tokens set to none.
Main flow: 1. The reader lists the Cursor database files. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/cursor.py:32`
2. The reader checks that the expected table exists. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/cursor.py:55`
3. It selects the composer rows through the read only helper. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/cursor.py:59`
4. It yields one event per composer with no tokens. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/cursor.py:79`
data.Alternative flows: A value that is not JSON is skipped. `src/ai_usage_cost/sources/cursor.py:66`
data.Acceptance criteria: The Cursor reader has its own test module. `tests/test_cursor.py:28`
